description: This file defines the LeaveCommentDecorator class, which provides methods to manipulate and access leave comment entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to set related employee, user, and leave references, and to format creation timestamps.

classes.name: LeaveCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for LeaveComment entity to facilitate setting references to Employee, User, and Leave entities, and formatting creation timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a LeaveComment entity.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee who created the comment, based on employee number.

methods.name: setCreatedByUserById
methods.description: Sets the user who created the comment, based on user ID.

methods.name: setLeaveById
methods.description: Associates the comment with a leave record by ID.

methods.name: getCreatedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date formatted as Y-m-d.

methods.name: getCreatedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time formatted as H:i.
